result.title: Independently review the release in real browsers
result.acceptance:
**Expected behaviour** · Assign a separate GLM 5.3 Flash QA reviewer. Run an independent pass against the same built candidate in real Edge and the built-in browser, covering account boundaries, offline Home retention, profile polish and existing workspace journeys.

**Verify** · Attach an independent report with real Windows launcher evidence, actual viewport sizes, browser actions, defects and reproducible results. Include Projects, Apps, SVAR, reader, Back, appearance and a second account.

**Delivery dependencies** · WI-075, WI-076

**Queue** · Follows WI-077 in the v0.3 delivery order.

**Target** · PI-03, v0.3.
